item.title: How Burp Suite Intercepts HTTPS: TLS, CA Certificates, On-the-Fly Certificates and Two TLS Sessions
item.description: Deep technical explanation of how Burp Suite intercepts HTTPS: CONNECT, TLS termination, Burp CA, per-host certificates, SNI, ALPN, HTTP/2, pinning, passthrough, invisible proxying and mTLS.
